newsitem.title: USA: Lawter Int'l says sales to resume growth.
newsitem.headline: Lawter Int'l says sales to resume growth.

text.p: Lawter International Inc, which earlier posted higher third-quarter earnings despite lower sales, said Thursday sales growth will resume this quarter.
"Management firmly believes that positive sales growth will return in the fourth quarter as will the continued improvement in earnings," the company said in a statement.
Lawter earlier said it earned $7.6 million, or $0.17 a share, in the third quarter compared to $7.2 million, or $0.16, in the same period last year.
Sales fell to $47.2 million from $51.0 million. Demand for printing ink in major markets, especially in Western Europe, remains soft, the company said.
